0ba69fd1469c83763187e73e64aef0f0814926a5.summary: Microsoft blog post (December 2020) on the SolarWinds Orion supply chain attack, which it describes as a nation-state espionage assault reaching US government agencies, security firms and other organisations. It also covers private offensive companies such as NSO Group, attacks on COVID-19 vaccine and health targets, AI-assisted disinformation, and calls for stronger public-private threat intelligence sharing and international rules.

subject.name: SolarWinds Orion software supply chain attack

hedges: The report says the source of these attacks is not yet proven and that it expects evidence about the source in the coming weeks.
The report says the Orion upgrade with malware 'may have been installed' by more than 17,000 customers.
The report says it 'appears' the attackers then chose a narrower set of victims from the customers they had installed on.
The report says the attack is ongoing and that the number and location of victims will keep growing.
Microsoft's statement says it found no evidence of access to production services or customer data, and that its investigations were ongoing.
The report says the AI use is 'what appears to be new steps' to weaponize stolen data, not a confirmed capability.
